title: Telemetry annotation system for multi-metric snapshots — visual guidance & handoff
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design, spec, and handoff of an annotation layer that surfaces telemetry context (model variant, route, cost bucket, rollout state) inline on multi-metric snapshot tiles. Objective: give engineers and support teams quick incident context without leaving the snapshot view. Focus areas: compact visual markers, explainable hover states, and a pattern for linking annotations to incident runs and retries.
acceptance_criteria: Annotation glyphs present on all snapshot tiles in prototype (desktop & tablet) and match contrast & size standards
Hover/press reveals a tooltip with up to 3 contextual rows: model, route, and rollout state; copy approved by PM
Annotations can be filtered in the snapshot toolbar and are included in export CSV with metadata columns
Design tokens and CSS vars documented; dev handoff checklist completed and initial QA pass green
comments: 2026-03-06 - PM Review (Liam O'Connor): Prefer 'rollout state' label to 'deployment tier' to align with Console language. Also request ability to mute annotations via user prefs. Link to PM spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/console/annotations-spec

2026-03-08 - Eng Review (Sophie Chen): Concern about render cost at scale; propose lazy-rendering for offscreen tiles and single DOM tooltip. See engineering notes PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/5421
2026-03-09 - Accessibility (Maya Patel): Glyph contrast passes AA, but hover target needs 24px min tappable area on mobile — adjust spacing variant. Added accessibility checklist item.

2026-03-11 - Design critique (Rohan Gupta): Iterated on glyph families: dot-with-accent vs. compact-pill. Team prefers dot-with-accent for density; created prototype link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/annotations-proto
2026-03-13 - Stakeholder (Ops - Daniel Park): Request a 'tracelink' action in tooltip that opens the incident timeline; suggested link format: /incidents/{id}?annotation={annot_id}
decisions: Use dot-with-accent glyph (single-color primary + micro-accent) to minimize visual weight — approved 2026-03-11
Tooltip will show three rows in priority: model > route > rollout_state; additional metadata hidden behind 'view details'
Default annotation visibility: on for Admins, off for Standard users — PM to confirm opt-in policy
review_feedback: Design QA (2026-03-12): Minor alignment issues at 1024px breakpoint; suggested +2px left padding for glyph group
Engineering (2026-03-08): Recommends reducing DOM nodes by rendering annotations in a canvas layer — follow-up spike required (ENG-41221)
Security (2026-03-13): Verify that annotation exports do not leak internal customer IDs; mask policy requested
